13B-187
STEP 13. Check for short circuit to ground and harness 
damage between left bank heated oxygen sensor (rear) 
connector B-23 terminal 4 and ECM connector C-62 
terminal 73 <M/T> or PCM connector C-59 terminal 73 <A/
T>.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 14.
NO : Repair it. Then go to Step 15.
STEP 14. Check the left bank heated oxygen sensor (rear).
(1) Disconnect the left bank heated oxygen sensor (rear) 
connector B-23 and connect test harness special tool, 
MB991316, to the connector on the left bank heated oxygen 
sensor (front) side.
(2) Warm up the engine until engine coolant 80° C (176° F) or 
higher.
CAUTION
Be very careful when connecting the jumper wires; 
incorrect connection can damage the left bank heated 
oxygen sensor (rear).
(3) Use the jumper wires to connect terminal 1 (red clip) to the 
positive battery terminal and terminal 3 (blue clip) to the 
negative battery terminal.
(4) Connect a digital volt meter between terminal 2 (black clip) 
and terminal 4 (white clip).
(5) While repeatedly revving the engine, measure the left bank 
heated oxygen sensor (rear) output voltage.
Standard value: 0.6 − 1.0 V
Q: Is the voltage at the standard value?
YES : Replace the ECM or PCM. Then go to Step 15.
NO : Replace the left bank heated oxygen sensor (rear). 
Then go to Step 15.
